close_reason: Landed in 0714edb. DownloadBlobParams.expected_sha256 now Option<&jmap_cid_types::Sha256>; the typed wrapper enforces the 64-char lowercase-hex ABNF at construction, eliminating the runtime is_valid_sha256_hex check, the to_ascii_lowercase normalize step, and the ClientError::InvalidArgument("expected_sha256 is not 64-char hex") branch at compile time. Two new integration tests in tests/client_tests.rs cover the typed-match-succeeds and typed-mismatch-returns-BlobIntegrityMismatch paths, oracles independent (NIST FIPS 180-4 Appendix A SHA-256("abc") and RFC 6234 SHA-256("")).
description: crate-jmap-base-client/src/blob.rs:43-44 declares pub expected_sha256: Option<&'a str> on the public DownloadBlobParams struct. After bd:JMAP-v9py.13 promoted BlobUploadResponse.sha256 from Option<String> to Option<jmap_cid_types::Sha256> precisely to make non-canonical digest values unrepresentable at the type level, this download-side counterpart is now the asymmetric exception: a caller can pass ANY string here and the function will fall back to runtime validation via is_valid_sha256_hex (blob.rs:387-403). The right shape is Option<&'a Sha256> (or perhaps Option<&'a jmap_cid_types::Sha256>) — then the constructor of Sha256 has already enforced the 64-lowercase-hex ABNF, the to_ascii_lowercase normalize step in download_blob disappears, the is_valid_sha256_hex helper becomes dead code, and the ClientError::InvalidArgument("expected_sha256 is not 64-char hex") branch is eliminated at compile time. The current design forces every caller to either carry a String through their code and risk a downstream InvalidArgument, or to construct a Sha256 and then call .as_str() at the call site — exactly the as_str-then-revalidate dance the typed wrapper exists to eliminate. Type-design: parse-don't-validate. This is a stronger argument than the upload-side typed change because download_blob's expected_sha256 is exclusively caller-supplied input (no server-side parse), so the typed shape eliminates the entire runtime-validation branch.
title: DownloadBlobParams.expected_sha256 is Option<&str>, not Option<&Sha256> — primitive obsession
